units.source_text: 如您所看到的，它比小幅的宽，比大幅的窄……就是说，这是用供出口用的锦纱质地做的。

en.t: As you can see, it is wider than the narrow width and narrower than the broad width... in other words, it is made from figured silk gauze intended for export.

units.source_text: 您可能已经知道，去年秋天横滨海关失火的时候，第一号仓库里进的货物是赛璐珞玩具，第二号仓库里进的是洋纸，第三号仓库里进的是今天带到这里来的腰带料子。

en.t: You may already know this, but when the Yokohama customs house caught fire last autumn, the goods in warehouse number one were celluloid toys, those in warehouse number two were Western paper, and those in warehouse number three were the sash fabrics brought here today.

units.source_text: 在仓库里不是腰带，是纯白的出口的锦纱。

en.t: In the warehouse they were not sashes, but pure white figured silk gauze for export.

units.source_text: 它为什么会成为腰带呈现在你们面前呢？

en.t: How, then, did it become a sash and appear before you?

units.source_text: 简直不知道该怎么说你们有多幸福。

en.t: I hardly know how to tell you just how fortunate you are.

units.source_text: 起火的原因是愚蠢的过往行人在赛璐珞仓库里吸烟，赛璐珞怕火比油怕火更厉害，所以立即燃起了熊熊的烈火，一直烧到第二号仓库的纸，幸亏第三号仓库得救了。

en.t: The fire started because a foolish passerby smoked in the celluloid warehouse; celluloid catches fire even more readily than oil, so it immediately burst into a roaring blaze and burned as far as the paper in warehouse number two, but fortunately warehouse number three was saved.

units.source_text: 但是一淋上水，白质地的料子就会出现无数的斑点，这是当然的。

en.t: But once water is poured over it, countless spots naturally appear on white fabric.

units.source_text: 可是不管怎么说，它是出口产品，必须办理麻烦的特别检查手续。

en.t: Even so, since it was an export product, it had to go through the troublesome procedures for a special inspection.

units.source_text: 这关系到日本的名誉问题。

en.t: This was a matter concerning Japan's honor.

units.source_text: 有斑点的产品，哪怕一尺也不能出口。

en.t: A spotted product could not be exported, not even a single foot of it.

units.source_text: 因此货主只好哭着将它拍卖。

en.t: Therefore the owner had no choice but to auction it off in tears.

units.source_text: 诸位大概也知道了，货主是横滨有名的丝绸批发商加山贝太郎。

en.t: As you probably know, the owner was Kayama Kaitaro, a famous silk wholesaler in Yokohama.

units.source_text: 这位先生召集了东京、横滨两地的三十三名同业者进行拍卖。

en.t: This gentleman gathered thirty-three fellow merchants from Tokyo and Yokohama and held an auction.
